description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter application implementing a calculator. It includes the main application widget, a calculator state handler class with input and evaluation logic, and the UI components such as display panel and keypad. The code structures how user interactions are processed, calculations are performed, and the UI is styled, emphasizing a themed design called 'Ocean Professional'.
